dict.string: Harbor asks Finder to empty the Trash, and Music or Spotify for the playback controls in its menu.
Harbor shows the Desktop folder's contents when you pin it to a dock or browse it from one.
Harbor shows the Documents folder's contents when you pin it to a dock or browse it from one.
Harbor shows the Downloads folder's contents when you pin it to a dock or browse it from one.
Harbor shows the contents of folders on external drives that you pin to a dock.
Harbor shows the contents of folders on network drives that you pin to a dock.
Harbor reads battery levels of connected Bluetooth accessories for the Bluetooth Battery widget.
